extraction.Name: Peter Condelario
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 320 acre allotment, on account of not wishing to pay the taxes; but that he was advised by the Indian Agency that it was necessary for him to accept it, and he did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the place to The State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1600.00; that he was unable to keep up the payments on this mortgage, and, in 1924, the bank foreclosed
extraction.Buyer: The State Bank of Interior, South Dakota (foreclosed in 1924)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: taxes got behind from 1919 until 1923, when he mortgaged the place to The State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1600.00; that he was unable to keep up the payments on this mortgage, and, in 1924, the bank foreclosed
extraction.Occupation/Income: income is derived entirely from following the carpentry trade
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health not very good; has a wife and five minor children to support; wife's health is very poor, and has been for ten years; children all have good health; has never received any help from the County or the Government; allotment was 320 acres; document number 1755; sworn November 19, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
